|game_text=If your starting location has exactly two [Light Side], play instead of a Starting Interrupt. ▼ two always [Immune to Alter] Effects. Deploy on table; ▲ and stack a Jedi here. '''Luminous Beings''': Whenever a Jedi is lost (or placed out of play) from table, may stack it here. Jedi stacked here are 'communing' and considered out of play. You generate +1 Force for each card stacked here. I Can't Believe He's Gone is canceled. Once per turn, if two cards here, may use 1 Force to look at top card of Reserve Deck, Force Pile, and/or Used Pile; return one card to each deck or pile.
|errata_history=This is errata version PC-E1 of [[Communing (Virtual Block 7)]]. Other versions: [[Communing (Virtual Block 7)]] (original) and [[Communing (Virtual Block 7) (Errata 2)]] (PC-E2, the current text). No published card image shows this text, so the image here is a CardMaker recreation of it ([[:File:VB7-00-Communing-PC-E1-cardmaker.png]], made 9 November 2026); the Players Committee card image and the release-sheet slip print PC-E2 (see [[Communing (Virtual Block 7) (Errata 2)]]).
* '''Original''' ([[Communing (Virtual Block 7)]], '''reconstructed'''): the first text of the card (Virtual Block 7.3, official text as of 3 June 2011). No copy of the first printing survives: the re-made 7.3 sheet, the Players Committee card image and the card lists all print later texts. The Players Committee news post “5 immediate changes from the CBT” (23 June 2011) gives the full errata text and says the errata added “I Can't Believe He's Gone is canceled”<ref name="src-S6">Players Committee news post "5 immediate changes from the CBT", 23 June 2011. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20110824051300/http://www.starwarsccg.org/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&id=323:5-immediate-changes-from-the-cbt&catid=1:latest-news&Itemid=117 Internet Archive]</ref>; so the original is rebuilt here as that errata text (PC-E1) without that sentence (Bill, 10 November 2026): “If your starting location has exactly two [Light Side], play instead of a Starting Interrupt. ▼ two always [Immune to Alter] Effects. Deploy on table; ▲ and stack a Jedi here. Luminous Beings: Whenever a Jedi is lost (or placed out of play) from table, may stack it here. Jedi stacked here are 'communing' and considered out of play. You generate +1 Force for each card stacked here. Once per turn, if two cards here, may use 1 Force to look at top card of Reserve Deck, Force Pile, and/or Used Pile; return one card to each deck or pile.” The earlier record of this page (“exactly 2 …, (that Jedi is 'communing') …”, without the once-per-turn look at top cards) had no source: it came from a truncated reading of the PC website card list, which actually prints the PC-E2 text in full.
* '''PC-E1''' (this page): the Players Committee news post “5 immediate changes from the CBT” (23 June 2011) printed the errata text, which cancels I Can't Believe He's Gone: “If your starting location has exactly two [Light Side], play instead of a Starting Interrupt. ▼ two always [Immune to Alter] Effects. Deploy on table; ▲ and stack a Jedi here. Luminous Beings: Whenever a Jedi is lost (or placed out of play) from table, may stack it here. Jedi stacked here are 'communing' and considered out of play. You generate +1 Force for each card stacked here. I Can't Believe He's Gone is canceled. Once per turn, if two cards here, may use 1 Force to look at top card of Reserve Deck, Force Pile, and/or Used Pile; return one card to each deck or pile.”.<ref name="src-S6">Players Committee news post "5 immediate changes from the CBT", 23 June 2011. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20110824051300/http://www.starwarsccg.org/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&id=323:5-immediate-changes-from-the-cbt&catid=1:latest-news&Itemid=117 Internet Archive]</ref> The same Competitive Balance Team errata was posted on the Players Committee rules forum on 22 June 2011, effective immediately, a day before the news post<ref name="pcforum-p632630">Players Committee forum, Rules board, thread “Current Rulings/Errata” (t=48201, now titled “Current Rulings Archive July 2010 - August 2012”), post by Aglets, 22 June 2011 ([https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=48201&start=20#p632630 forum post])</ref>. The forum copy (forum posts can be edited later) already has “(that Jedi is 'communing')” and “Jedi stacked here are considered out of play”, which the re-made sheet (PC-E2) prints.
* '''PC-E2''' ([[Communing (Virtual Block 7) (Errata 2)]]): the re-made Virtual Block 7.3 release sheet (still headed 3 June 2011, PDF dated 25 July 2011) printed “exactly 2”, “Deploy on table. ▲ and stack a Jedi here (that Jedi is ‘communing’)” and “Jedi stacked here are considered out of play”: “If your starting location has exactly 2 [Light Side], play instead of a Starting Interrupt. ▼ two always [Immune to Alter] Effects. Deploy on table. ▲ and stack a Jedi here (that Jedi is ‘communing’). Luminous Beings: Whenever a Jedi is lost (or placed out of play) from table, may stack it here. Jedi stacked here are considered out of play. You generate +1 Force for each card stacked here. I Can’t Believe He’s Gone is canceled. Once per turn, if two cards here, may use 1 Force to look at top card of Reserve Deck, Force Pile, and/or Used Pile; return one card to each deck or pile.”.<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock7_3">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock7_3.pdf#page=6 Virtual Block 7.3 release sheet] ("Official text as of 3 June 2011"; copy re-made 25 July 2011), page 6, slip 33 (position on the sheet; the slip prints no number). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261022223058/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock7_3.pdf#page=6 Internet Archive]</ref> The PC website card list (by 21 July 2012) and the Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013; Light Side, p. 31) print the same words (the card list with “starting interrupt”, “Deploy on table;” and “Is canceled”: capitals and punctuation only, held for a ruling).<ref name="cl-1273_33-2012-07-21">Players Committee website card list (VBlock7Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064742/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock7Type.html 2012-07-21] and [https://web.archive.org/web/20121211205229/http://www.starwarsccg.org/cardlists/VBlock7Type.html 2012-12-11] (Internet Archive)</ref><ref name="ml-ls">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_LS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Light Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf#page=31, page 31. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170705013057/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf#page=31 Internet Archive]</ref>
